text:
kevin: Heads-up: we flipped L7 body capture on fw-eu-canary at 02:58 to satisfy a compliance sample. Immediately saw a surge in keystore decrypt requests and GPU node joins started failing.
li: Saw the same in the node logs — kubelet failing to decrypt /etc/keystore. Snippet:
```
Feb 17 02:59:03 kubelet[4321]: decrypt error: KMS ThrottlingException: GrantsPerSecondExceeded
Feb 17 02:59:03 kubelet[4321]: retries exhausted
```
marta: That makes sense. The audit pipeline has two ingestion modes; the canary switch routed events direct to S3 which means each event causes a keystore decrypt. We didn't anticipate the fanout.
raj: Region impact? Is this localized?
kevin: Mostly eu-west-1. Small blip in us-west but below alert.
security_jen: We need to revert ASAP. Compliance expects richer logs but stability first. Recommend reverting to headers-only + enable sampling 5% until we design a safe rollout.
li: On it. Patching firewall policy now:
```
fwctl apply --cluster fw-eu-canary --set audit.l7_payload=false && fwctl sampling set 0.05 --region eu-west-1
```
ops-bot: Runbook triggered: keystore/mass-onboard-retry. Plan: cordon and drain failed nodes, restart kubelet, re-trigger decrypt flow. ETA 18m.
marta: After the revert decrypt success went from ~58% -> 95% within 10 minutes. Autoscaler resumed provisioning.
raj: Action items: short-term keep payload off + sampling for 12 hours; medium-term route L7 payload through aggregator so we batch decrypts; long-term request KMS grant QPS increase for keystore service or add a local grant cache.
security_jen: I'll document an approved compliance exception for the sampling window and draft the aggregator design review.
kevin: Cost note: direct S3 ingestion increased KMS decrypt units and S3 PUTs; rough extra spend estimate ~+10% for eu-west during the 40m experiment. Add to incident cost report.
li: Suggest adding an automated safety rollback: alarm on keystore.decrypt/error_rate > 3% for 2 minutes triggers policy revert. small lambda + fwctl.
marta: +1. I'll open INFRA-1302 to track the rollback guard, aggregator rollout, and KMS quota request.
ops-bot: Incident filed: incident/1739998881 - "fw-eu L7 payload -> KMS grant surge causing GPU onboard failures". Link: incident doc and runbook logs.
security_jen: Owners: li (rollback + automation), marta (rollout guard + ticket), raj (runbook updates). Scheduling compliance review next Thursday.
kevin: Closing loop: immediate revert restored onboarding, no external customer impact observed. We'll proceed with guarded aggregator rollout.
